packageVerification.note: Windows verified the installed Store package identity, pinned publisher, signing kind, status, content integrity and executable signature. This review uses that signed Store package. No standalone MSIX signature/hash is claimed for this newer build.

checks.detail: Every patch selection composes deterministically, parses and preserves unrelated entries. Standalone module and default archive/header/executable hashes match the independent review pins.

checks.name: local-Ubuntu-26.04-WSL2-toolkit-and-native-runtime
checks.detail: Current native stock failures and patched paths, listing/filtering/pagination, pairing reuse/reconnect, connector discovery/errors/authentication, cache alignment and membership persistence in temporary state. Source and GraphQL tests ran separately.

checks.name: stock-WSL2-app-server
checks.scope: Bundled stock CLI under Ubuntu WSL2 with temporary home/database and no user credentials.

patchDecisions.app: All seven app patches remain needed. Current source revisions cover the changed pet loader, Browser predicate/capability/hook/publisher, native membership gate/synchronizer, inlined runtime sync/reconciler and managed-pipe defaults, service generator and native theme updater.
patchDecisions.runtime: All four runtime patches remain needed with bundled CLI 0.167.0-alpha.3.2. Native regression tests reproduce stock defects and verify adapter behavior.
patchDecisions.pet: Stock still joins a Windows home with POSIX path semantics. Actual-source discovery, selection, installation, collision and traversal checks pass with the path patch.
patchDecisions.security: Existing workspace/provider restrictions, authorization and Work policy denials, account-switch checks, authenticated/API-key identities, latest disables, local-only audio and active-turn protection remain covered. The newly inlined authorization function is executed directly.
patchDecisions.fixtures: Isolated queue tests replace only the inlined sync callee with a fixture; integration tests execute the native sync body. The managed-pipe fixture supplies the existing ensure/configuration dependency instead of executing its default filesystem initializer.
patchDecisions.retired: The GraphQL shell guard and pet-home aliases remain retired. Current stock inlined GitHub/WSL command generators preserve variables and apostrophe arguments across Windows Node and wsl.exe.

proposal.originalCandidate: preserved unchanged; not allowlisted by this review
proposal.note: The installed Store build is newer than the proposal. This review supports only 26.1103.4239.0. Local WSL2 results are recorded separately from the older hosted proposal failure.

limitations: No generated app copy was activated; the app was not restarted and saved settings/data were not changed.
Current-build Application Control permission, startup, desktop theme, interactive pets, actual agent Browser/Computer Use, authenticated connector inventory and real-phone reconnect remain pending.
Existing Application Control and initial theme-mismatch observations remain recorded. Android project-label display remains a separate accepted limitation.
Local WSL2 passes do not establish a hosted WSL2 pass for this Store build.
